relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a 14-year-old boy with an ABCA1 variant diagnosed with Tangier disease: 'we diagnosed the patient with a genetic Tangier disease'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and checked spans. Three people in scope: the unnamed proband ('patient'), his mother (tested carrier) and his father (tested, no mutation); other family members ('immediate family members of the parents') are described only as a group and get no rows. Table 1 (blood lipids of patient and parents at 3 years) has no content in the Markdown, so nothing was read from it. Contradictions/inconsistencies in the paper: (1) the abstract says 'ABCD1 gene mutation' while the text says ABCA1; gene recorded as ABCA1 from the case text. (2) The variant is printed as 'c.598G>A, p.1068R>H' (exon22) in the text but as '3203G>A' in the Figure 3 legend; the text string was recorded and the figure-legend string not split into a second variant row. (3) The Discussion says the patient had 'hepatosplenomegaly' (case presentation ultrasound mentions only fatty liver) but also that he 'did not present anemia, liver abnormalities'; both rows emitted, hepatomegaly checklist set to not reported. (4) The mother is called 'a healthy gene carrier' but also has a history of 'hypertension and diabetes'. (5) The Discussion says the patient's HDL 'normalized after treatment' yet HDL was 0.506 mmol/L three months after discharge. (6) Cervical vessel ultrasound reported normal while DSA showed left internal carotid stenosis (C6/C7 segments). Numeric lab values printed only with reference ranges and not characterized in words (uric acid, creatine kinase, LDH, LDL 3.24 mmol/L, ESR, CRP) were not turned into features; low LDL checklist left not reported. Normal whole investigations ('blood routine test', coagulation tests, electrocardiogram, heart and cervical-vessel ultrasound) were recorded as written and exclude nothing more specific; thrombocytopenia left not reported. Coronary artery disease marked excluded for the patient from 'without high-risk factors, such as ... heart disease'. Mother's diabetes not mapped to the glucose-intolerance checklist item. Parents' normal HDL taken from the Discussion statement naming 'the parents'. Variant type, pathogenicity and functional evidence are not stated for the variant. Mother's variant row uses the proband's printed variant because the paper states the patient's mutation was acquired from her; her zygosity is not stated. Resolution of aphasia at 3-year follow-up ('no aphasia') was not recorded as an excluded row, since it describes recovery of an observed feature.
